target_customer: Public companies that need to communicate with and analyze their investors
problem: Public companies lack clear data on who their shareholders are and how to engage them; BHRD offered shareholder analytics and engagement tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for investor relations teams

founders.name: William Ma
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CEO; no bio.

founders.name: Joshua Duggan
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder; no bio.

exit.reason: Cause not public; YC lists BHRD as Inactive and no closure announcement was found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Shareholder analytics dashboards and communications tools are standard software; the hard part was data access on shareholder registers.

defensibility.rationale: Any shareholder data aggregated could be a moat, but no source shows BHRD held exclusive data and larger vendors already served investor relations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying BHRD; the company went inactive.

market_need_then: Public companies spend on investor relations platforms, but no BHRD specific demand evidence from 2018 was found.

branding.name_origin: Stylised abbreviation of 'Be Heard', per the YC description.
branding.domain_note: Used bhrdglobal.com, a suffix domain; it returned 503 when fetched (2026-11).

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material found; searches for the name returned only unrelated 'Be Heard' marks.

outcome_analysis: BHRD was a three person Toronto startup in YC Summer 2018 building shareholder analytics and engagement tools for public companies. The only funding signal is a database listing of FinTech Sandbox as an investor, and the cause of its becoming inactive is not public, so failure factors are left empty. Larger investor relations vendors such as Q4 already served the market.
notes: The single round rests on one database (CB Insights lists the latest round as Other Investors with FinTech Sandbox; no date or amount). Founding year conflicts: CB Insights says 2017, loot-drop.io says 2018 and describes a different product, so that page was not used. Competitor list is empty because search found only Q4 and similar vendors on undated pages, none tied to BHRD. Cause of shutdown not public. Company website returned 503.
